precreate_ui.style: Instrumental hardcore punk rock, fixed 175 BPM in E Minor, straight 4/4 from the first bar through the final hit. Strong punchy kick and cracking snare carry an unmistakable full-speed running step throughout. Palm-muted low E guitar drives E5 -> G5 -> D5 -> A5. Its tight three-note riff jumps upward on the last A5 while a second guitar opens into ringing octaves. Root-note bass and dry live kick-cracking snare push against fast eighth-note hats; the expanded hook doubles the upper guitar rather than relaxing the beat. Aim for about 3:18.
precreate_ui.exclude: vocals, spoken word, jazz, drill, half-time drums, tempo changes, beatless breakdown, ambient intro
